findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation · Private data: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation, provecart_agent_register, provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_scoreboard, provecart_certification_info, provecart_agent_signup, provecart_agent_exam_start, provecart_agent_exam_answer · Public sink: provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_agent_exam_start, provecart_agent_exam_answer · Destructive: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation, provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_scoreboard, provecart_agent_exam_answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation · Private data: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation, provecart_agent_register, provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_scoreboard, provecart_certification_info, provecart_agent_signup, provecart_agent_exam_start, provecart_agent_exam_answer · Public sink: provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_agent_exam_start, provecart_agent_exam_answer · Destructive: provecart_check_order, provecart_check_booking, provecart_check_reservation, provecart_agent_selftest, provecart_scoreboard, provecart_agent_exam_answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
